units.source_zh: 但经过了去岁冬役的议和，信十郎还会如从前那般，保持着高度警惕和紧张吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 所有恶果，家康不是没有想过。为了防止最坏的结果出现，他早就命柳生又右卫门把奥原信十郎丰政安插到了大坂。但经过了去岁冬役的议和，信十郎还会如从前那般，保持着高度警惕和紧张吗？

paragraphs.source_en: “Where is Yagyu Mataemon now?” Ieyasu asked Oguri Tadamasa, the messenger who still remained at his side.

units.source_en: “Where is Yagyu Mataemon now?”
units.source_zh: “柳生又右卫门现在何处？”

units.source_en: Ieyasu asked Oguri Tadamasa, the messenger who still remained at his side.
units.source_zh: 家康问仍留在身旁的传令使小栗忠政道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “柳生又右卫门现在何处？”家康问仍留在身旁的传令使小栗忠政道。

paragraphs.source_en: Tadamasa answered at once, “He is with the shogun, preparing for the campaign.”

units.source_en: Tadamasa answered at once, “He is with the shogun, preparing for the campaign.”
units.source_zh: 忠政当即答道：“在将军身边，正在为出兵准备。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠政当即答道：“在将军身边，正在为出兵准备。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Since he bears the grave responsibility of protecting the shogun, he certainly cannot come.”

units.source_en: “Since he bears the grave responsibility of protecting the shogun, he certainly cannot come.”
units.source_zh: “他既担负着保护将军的重任，定无法来了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “他既担负着保护将军的重任，定无法来了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “If the matter is urgent...”

units.source_en: “If the matter is urgent...”
units.source_zh: “若有要事……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “若有要事……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Mataichi, the key man inside Osaka Castle now is Shuri.”

units.source_en: “Mataichi, the key man inside Osaka Castle now is Shuri.”
units.source_zh: “又一，现在大坂城内的关键人物是修理。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “又一，现在大坂城内的关键人物是修理。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Him?”

units.source_en: “Him?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, him.” Ieyasu nodded, his gaze keen. “The best way to save Lady Yodo and the Minister of the Right is to persuade Shuri.”

units.source_en: “Yes, him.”
units.source_zh: “是他。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu nodded, his gaze keen. “The best way to save Lady Yodo and the Minister of the Right is to persuade Shuri.”
units.source_zh: 家康目光锐利，点头道，“要救淀夫人和右府，最好的办法便是说服修理。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是他。”家康目光锐利，点头道，“要救淀夫人和右府，最好的办法便是说服修理。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Your Lordship intends to persuade Ono Shuri?”

units.source_en: “Your Lordship intends to persuade Ono Shuri?”
units.source_zh: “大人要说服大野修理？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人要说服大野修理？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Precisely. Shuri is indecisive. I shall make him prepare himself to rescue the Minister of the Right and the lady without fail, and to preserve the lives of mother and son whatever may happen.”

units.source_en: “Precisely.
units.source_zh: “正是。

units.source_en: Shuri is indecisive. I shall make him prepare himself to rescue the Minister of the Right and the lady without fail, and to preserve the lives of mother and son whatever may happen.”
units.source_zh: 修理优柔寡断，我要让他作好准备，一定要把右府和夫人救出来，无论发生何事，也要保全他们母子性命。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正是。修理优柔寡断，我要让他作好准备，一定要把右府和夫人救出来，无论发生何事，也要保全他们母子性命。”

paragraphs.source_en: Oguri Tadamasa blinked, utterly perplexed. Ono Harunaga was neither an ally nor a vassal of the eastern provinces; he was now the supreme commander of the enemy. Yet Ieyasu intended to persuade such an adversary. Naturally, he was greatly astonished.

units.source_en: Oguri Tadamasa blinked, utterly perplexed.

ja.t: をしばたたかせ、ひどく

units.source_zh: 小栗忠政眨眨眼睛，深感纳闷。

units.source_en: Ono Harunaga was neither an ally nor a vassal of the eastern provinces; he was now the supreme commander of the enemy.
units.source_zh: 大野治长既非关东的盟友，也非关东的家臣，他现在乃是敌人的总帅。

units.source_en: Yet Ieyasu intended to persuade such an adversary.
units.source_zh: 家康竟要说服这样一个对手。

units.source_en: Naturally, he was greatly astonished.

ja.t: かずにはいられなかった。

units.source_zh: 他自吃惊不小。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小栗忠政眨眨眼睛，深感纳闷。大野治长既非关东的盟友，也非关东的家臣，他现在乃是敌人的总帅。家康竟要说服这样一个对手。他自吃惊不小。

paragraphs.source_en: “I do not understand. Ono Shuri ought to be our enemy.”

units.source_en: “I do not understand. Ono Shuri ought to be our enemy.”
units.source_zh: “小人不解，大野修理应该是我们的敌人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “小人不解，大野修理应该是我们的敌人。”

paragraphs.source_en: Oguri Mataichi departed Nagoya that very day and hastened toward Kyoto.

units.source_en: Oguri Mataichi departed Nagoya that very day and hastened toward Kyoto.
units.source_zh: 小栗又一当日就从名古屋出发，赶奔京都。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小栗又一当日就从名古屋出发，赶奔京都。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's departure from Nagoya was set for the fifteenth. Yoshinao, who had married Asano Yoshinaga's daughter on the thirteenth, followed close behind his father and marched out at the head of his troops.

units.source_en: Ieyasu's departure from Nagoya was set for the fifteenth.
units.source_zh: 家康从名古屋出发定于十五日。

units.source_en: Yoshinao, who had married Asano Yoshinaga's daughter on the thirteenth, followed close behind his father and marched out at the head of his troops.
units.source_zh: 十三日与浅野幸长之女完婚的义直紧跟在父亲身后，率领军队出发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康从名古屋出发定于十五日。十三日与浅野幸长之女完婚的义直紧跟在父亲身后，率领军队出发。

paragraphs.source_en: The moment for battle was ripe. The slightest negligence could deliver Nijo Castle, Fushimi, Yodo Castle, and other strongholds into enemy hands.

units.source_en: The moment for battle was ripe.
units.source_zh: 战机已经成熟。

units.source_en: The slightest negligence could deliver Nijo Castle, Fushimi, Yodo Castle, and other strongholds into enemy hands.
units.source_zh: 稍有疏忽，二条城、伏见、淀城等就会落入敌手。

paragraphs.source_zh: 战机已经成熟。稍有疏忽，二条城、伏见、淀城等就会落入敌手。

paragraphs.source_en: On the fourteenth, Ieyasu ordered Yamauchi Tadayoshi of Tosa and Kamei Korenori of Shikano in Inaba to take the field at once, while he himself departed Nagoya the following day as planned.

units.source_en: On the fourteenth, Ieyasu ordered Yamauchi Tadayoshi of Tosa and Kamei Korenori of Shikano in Inaba to take the field at once, while he himself departed Nagoya the following day as planned.
units.source_zh: 十四日，家康向土佐的山内忠义和因幡鹿野的龟井兹矩发出了早早出征的命令，自己则按原计于次日从名古屋出发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十四日，家康向土佐的山内忠义和因幡鹿野的龟井兹矩发出了早早出征的命令，自己则按原计于次日从名古屋出发。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu then asked, “What? Even now, has no one taken the money and fled?”

units.source_en: Ieyasu then asked, “What? Even now, has no one taken the money and fled?”
units.source_zh: 家康转问：“怎的，事到如今，还无人揣着钱走掉？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康转问：“怎的，事到如今，还无人揣着钱走掉？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No. Fearing desertions, Shuri has even formed units to enforce discipline.”

units.source_en: “No.
Fearing desertions, Shuri has even formed units to enforce discipline.”
units.source_zh: 怕是担心有人逃散，修理还组建了督战队。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “无。怕是担心有人逃散，修理还组建了督战队。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Units to enforce discipline?”

units.source_en: “Units to enforce discipline?”
units.source_zh: “督战队？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “督战队？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Consequently, even if Aoki Kazushige and the old women return to Osaka, they will probably be unable to enter the castle.”

units.source_en: “Consequently, even if Aoki Kazushige and the old women return to Osaka, they will probably be unable to enter the castle.”
units.source_zh: “因此，即便是青木一重和老女人们返回大坂，估计也进不了城。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “因此，即便是青木一重和老女人们返回大坂，估计也进不了城。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh?”

units.source_en: “Oh?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Every one of them is suspected of secretly communicating with the eastern provinces. The city is now full of such rumors: that Oda Joshin and Urakusai have secretly joined the eastern side; that everyone involved in last year's peace negotiations is suspect; that they are all eastern sympathizers...”

units.source_en: “Every one of them is suspected of secretly communicating with the eastern provinces.

units.source_zh: “每人都有与关东私通的嫌疑。

units.source_en: The city is now full of such rumors: that Oda Joshin and Urakusai have secretly joined the eastern side; that everyone involved in last year's peace negotiations is suspect; that they are all eastern sympathizers...”
units.source_zh: 目下这类传言满城皆是：织田常真和有乐斋已私通了关东，去岁战时所有参与议和之人都有嫌疑，他们都是关东同党……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “每人都有与关东私通的嫌疑。目下这类传言满城皆是：织田常真和有乐斋已私通了关东，去岁战时所有参与议和之人都有嫌疑，他们都是关东同党……”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu remained unmoved. “Hah! Does Lady Yodo want a final battle as well?”

units.source_en: Ieyasu remained unmoved. “Hah! Does Lady Yodo want a final battle as well?”
units.source_zh: 家康不为所动，“嘿，淀夫人也想决战了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康不为所动，“嘿，淀夫人也想决战了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. She seems to have gone mad, shouting that Your Lordship deceived her and that she cannot stomach the humiliation.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
She seems to have gone mad, shouting that Your Lordship deceived her and that she cannot stomach the humiliation.”
units.source_zh: 她似已发疯，大嚷被大人欺诳，咽不下这口气云云。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。她似已发疯，大嚷被大人欺诳，咽不下这口气云云。”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu suddenly recalled Uraku's words and shook his head repeatedly. Another Tsukiyama! It was difficult to believe that ghosts existed in this world, yet people who behaved wantonly as though possessed by one arose without end. Unable to love, unable to hate, their love and loathing became entangled as they wheeled endlessly through madness...

units.source_en: Ieyasu suddenly recalled Uraku's words and shook his head repeatedly.
units.source_zh: 家康忽然想起有乐之言，摇头不已。

units.source_en: Another Tsukiyama!
units.source_zh: 又一个筑山！

units.source_en: It was difficult to believe that ghosts existed in this world, yet people who behaved wantonly as though possessed by one arose without end.
units.source_zh: 很难相信世间会有鬼魂，但仿佛被鬼魂附体般肆意妄为之人，却绵绵不绝。

units.source_en: Unable to love, unable to hate, their love and loathing became entangled as they wheeled endlessly through madness...
units.source_zh: 他们欲爱不能，欲恨不行，爱憎纠缠，在癫狂中轮回……

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康忽然想起有乐之言，摇头不已。又一个筑山！很难相信世间会有鬼魂，但仿佛被鬼魂附体般肆意妄为之人，却绵绵不绝。他们欲爱不能，欲恨不行，爱憎纠缠，在癫狂中轮回……

paragraphs.source_en: “You have done well. It appears that war cannot be avoided. Hurry back and tell them not to commence hostilities before I arrive.”

units.source_en: “You have done well.
units.source_zh: “辛苦了。

units.source_en: It appears that war cannot be avoided.
units.source_zh: 看来战事不能免。

units.source_en: Hurry back and tell them not to commence hostilities before I arrive.”
units.source_zh: 赶紧回去，告诉他们，在我到达之前不可开战。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “辛苦了。看来战事不能免。赶紧回去，告诉他们，在我到达之前不可开战。”

paragraphs.source_en: He reached Minakuchi on the seventeenth. On the eighteenth, Ieyasu entered Nijo Castle, which he had believed he would never see again in this life.

units.source_en: He reached Minakuchi on the seventeenth.
units.source_zh: 十七日抵达水口。

units.source_en: On the eighteenth, Ieyasu entered Nijo Castle, which he had believed he would never see again in this life.
units.source_zh: 十八日，家康进入了本以为今生不会再见到的二条城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十七日抵达水口。十八日，家康进入了本以为今生不会再见到的二条城。

paragraphs.source_en: After entering the castle, Ieyasu first asked Oguri Tadamasa, who had come to meet him, whether contact had been made with Oko. Learning that it had, he breathed a sigh of relief and quietly awaited Shogun Hidetada...

units.source_en: After entering the castle, Ieyasu first asked Oguri Tadamasa, who had come to meet him, whether contact had been made with Oko.
units.source_zh: 进城之后，家康先是询问出迎的小栗忠政与阿小是否联络上。

units.source_en: Learning that it had, he breathed a sigh of relief and quietly awaited Shogun Hidetada...

paragraphs.source_zh: 进城之后，家康先是询问出迎的小栗忠政与阿小是否联络上。得知已联络，他松了一口气，静静等待着将军秀忠……
